user.title: Choose setup type
user.description: ScorpionTrack can be connected either with your portal account for the richer integration or with a shared-location link for lightweight read-only tracking.

account.title: Add portal account
account.description: Enter your ScorpionTrack portal credentials. You can also add a shared-location link for faster live position updates while retaining account sensors and controls.

data_description.share_token: Optional: add a share containing the same vehicle(s) to refresh live location, speed, heading, ignition, and status every two minutes.

share.title: Add shared location
share.description: Paste either the full ScorpionTrack shared-location URL or just the token from it. A single share can include multiple vehicles.

data_description.share_token: Paste the full ScorpionTrack shared-location URL or just the token itself.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to ScorpionTrack. Please try again.
error.invalid_auth: Your ScorpionTrack username or password is incorrect, or the portal asked for an extra verification step that this integration cannot complete.
error.invalid_token: Your shared-location link is invalid or incomplete.
error.share_unavailable: Your shared-location link is invalid, expired, has been revoked, or no longer returns data.
error.reauth_account_mismatch: These credentials belong to a different ScorpionTrack account.
error.unexpected_response: ScorpionTrack returned something unexpected. Turn on debug logging and try again.

abort.already_configured: This ScorpionTrack source is already configured.
abort.reauth_successful: Your ScorpionTrack credentials have been updated.

init.title: ScorpionTrack options
init.description: Choose how speed is displayed. Portal-account entries can also add, replace, or remove an optional shared-location feed for faster live updates.

data_description.share_token: Leave blank to use portal-account data only. The share should contain the same vehicle(s) as the account.

cannot_connect.message: ScorpionTrack could not be reached right now.

invalid_auth.message: ScorpionTrack rejected the configured account credentials.

invalid_token.message: ScorpionTrack rejected the configured share token.

mark_alerts_read_failed.message: ScorpionTrack could not mark the alerts as read.

unsupported_setup_type.message: The ScorpionTrack configuration source is not supported.
